subject: Reactive object in render* seems to break argument defaulting

messages.author: 8a732eca9bfcf407
messages.subject: Reactive object in render* seems to break argument defaulting
parts:
I am writing a shiny app where I am loading large 3D imaging files and displaying 2D images through that volume. My plotting function relies on many default arguments, some of which don't seem to get picked up when rendering the plot. Here's the simplest example I could think of that breaks:

server.R
-----------------------------------

shinyServer <-
  function(input, output, clientData, session) {
   
    toy_plot <-
      function(volume, dimension = 1, index = dim(volume)[dimension]){
        if(index > 1)
          plot(1:index)
      }
   
    current_volume <- reactive({
      vol <- 1:125
      dim(vol) <- c(5,5,5)
      vol
    })
   
    output$plot <- renderPlot({
      toy_plot(current_volume(), dimension = input$dimension)
    })
   
  }

ui.R
------------------------------------

shinyUI(
  mainPanel(
    selectInput("dimension", "Dimension", choices = c(1,2,3)), #I tried manually specifying selected, no avail
    plotOutput("plot")
  )
)

-----------------------------------

The server complains about not being able to find index, which when running R normally is picked up as the size of the chosen dimension, defaulting to the first. It seems to be the reactive object `current_volume` that's the problem. I can message out `dim(current_volume())`, which returns the right answer, `input$dimension` which returns the right answer, but `dim(current_volume())[input$dimension]` returns NA.

Any thoughts?

Chris

messages.subject: Re: Reactive object in render* seems to break argument defaulting
parts: Thanks for the excellent repro case. input$dimension is a string, not a number--selectInput always returns its values as strings. If you call toy_plot(current_volume(), dimension = as.numeric(input$dimension)), it should work.
